summary: Video course marketplace — commoditized instructional content is highly vulnerable to interactive AI learning assistants.
moat: Udemy's moat is its breadth: over 250,000 courses across virtually every skill domain, combined with a 73-million-learner base that creates social proof through ratings and reviews. Its B2B Udemy Business offering embeds it in corporate L&D budgets with renewal cycles. The weakness is structural: most Udemy courses teach skills through passive video watching, a format that AI tutors demonstrably outperform on retention and speed.

challengers.name: AI coding assistants replacing tutorial courses
challengers.evidence: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude teach developers interactively while they code, replacing the need to purchase Udemy programming courses — the platform's largest revenue category.
